name: web-checkout-form-desktop-and-mobile
title: Order checkout page in blue and grey, desktop and mobile
whatItIs: A lilac-blue board with numbered header 'Making an order' and two views of a B2B checkout: sections for buyer type and region, payment, buyer details and an order table with item thumbnails, followed by a blue submit button.
whatItMeans: Orderly and calm; grouped white cards with light grey fields make a long form feel manageable.
techniques: Split a long form into titled white cards with small icons.
Use light grey filled inputs with tiny labels and a single blue action.
Lay the order table beneath the form with thumbnails, price and quantity columns.
Reuse the same card structure at mobile width.

vocabulary.definition: A grouped set of related fields in one container.
A field with a soft grey background rather than outline.
A list of line items with price and quantity.
